decision: commit on local branch p0/P0-1, no push, no PR
why: gh and an origin CLI are absent; the operator pushes and merges

decision: scripts run node --test "test/conformance/*.test.js" instead of node --test test/conformance
why: Node 22 and later treat --test arguments as globs, so a bare directory is loaded as a module and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND (seen on Node 24.15)
result: glob form passes on Node 24; Node expands the quoted glob itself so it works in cmd and sh

decision: conformance files stay plain scripts that print OK; node --test reports each file as one test
why: keeps node <file> [seed] working (lane 4) and the case bodies identical to trunk
result: every trunk case name present at head

decision: startHubProcess also passes --history when the test gives one
why: sync and chat tests used a separate history dir at trunk; lanhub-cli accepts --history per A-lanhub A2

decision: hub.js parseArgs treats a flag followed by another --flag or nothing as true
why: --stop-on-stdin-close takes no value and would otherwise swallow the next argument
result: --port 0 already parsed to 0, no change needed there

decision: an unexpected hub exit prints 'hub exited (code, signal)' plus the hub's last log lines and exits the test process 1
why: the test's own waits would only time out later with a misleading message; hub children exit on stdin close so nothing is orphaned

decision: --no-discovery is not passed by the helper yet
why: the Node hub has no discovery until P0-2; P0-2 adds the flag and the helper default per README 5.4 item 11

decision: loadgen clients wait for each ack before the next op and send on a due time polled every 2 ms; loadgen spawns its own hub through hub-process.js; RSS is the tasklist working set on Windows and VmRSS on Linux
why: stop-and-wait needs only the document length to build valid ops; setInterval(50) on Windows timers gave 16 ops/s instead of 20

decision: mutant hub dropping every tenth applyOp fails sync.test.js only on the no-delete seeds 101-104; seeds 1-4 still pass
why: clients' hash check resyncs the divergence and the text loss is only caught by the character count; same property at trunk, not changed here
result: unit box passes; weakness noted for later PRs

decision: first loadgen baseline on the Node hub, loopback, this machine: 10 clients x 20 ops/s x 30 s ackRttP50 0.64 ms ackRttP99 7.51 ms fanoutP50 0.57 ms fanoutP99 7.32 ms 200.1 ops/s hub RSS 67 MB
why: absolute baseline A2 and later compare against

decision: perf probe 5 interleaved npm test runs: trunk median 37.55 s, head median 36.01 s
why: rule is head <= trunk + 5 s; head runs the four files in parallel under node --test which offsets the spawn cost

decision: committed on local branch p0/P0-3 and stopped there, no push
why: gh and an origin CLI are absent, the operator pushes and merges

decision: pinned typescript 6.0.3, not the newest stable 7.0.2
why: svelte-check 4.7.7 declares peer typescript ^5 or ^6, so 7.0.2 breaks the required check

decision: ran npm install --before=2026-10-24
why: keeps direct and transitive dependencies at least two weeks old, not only the six named packages
evidence: package-lock.json: svelte 5.57.2, vite 8.3.5, plugin 7.3.1, svelte-check 4.7.7, vitest 5.0.5

decision: added --no-dependencies to the package script
why: with workspaces vsce 3 follows node_modules/@lan-collab/ui-kit and aborts with 'not a file'; the extension has no runtime dependencies
result: vsix 17 files, no packages/ lanhub/ docs/

decision: lane 1 head list equals trunk list minus the 7 docs/plans files
why: trunk 56cd7cc packs docs/plans; the spec's .vscodeignore entry docs/** removes them on purpose, so exact equality cannot hold

decision: checked the file list with vsce ls --no-dependencies
why: that is what npm run package runs; bare vsce ls also lists 954 devDependency files under node_modules, none under packages/ lanhub/ docs/

decision: gallery renders one theme per page, chosen by ?theme= and a switcher
why: theme-app.css and theme-vscode.css both define --lc- tokens on :root, and the VS Code variants must reproduce the webview setup of variables on html and a class on body

decision: check-tokens also fails on unknown --lc- tokens, theme parity gaps and body-text contrast below 4.5:1
why: lane 3 reads contrast from the check script output, and a typo in a token name renders silently
result: OK on head, exit 1 on the scratch edit

decision: darkened the dark accent-hover to #2f62d0
why: white on the first value #4a7cec measured 3.90:1

decision: added vitest test for visibleRange in src/virtual.ts
why: window math has edge cases at the end of the list and after the list shrinks

decision: drove lanes 4 to 9 with a scratch CDP script on headless Edge
why: tools/cdp from P0-4 has not landed; synthetic DOM events cannot move focus, CDP input can

decision: added Tooltip align and a contrast-border ring on checked Switch and Checkbox
why: the light screenshot showed the open tooltip crossing its card edge, and in high contrast a checked control had a black border on black

decision: runCommand goes through a dev-only bridge extension (tools/cdp/bridge, loaded as a second --extensionDevelopmentPath) that runs vscode.commands.executeCommand on a loopback port; palette(text) kept for UI-path checks
why: extension commands live in the extension host, which CDP on the workbench renderer cannot call; the palette takes no args, returns nothing and depends on localized titles
result: runCommand with args and error propagation works; palette works

decision: bridge hands its port and token over through <user-data-dir>/User/globalStorage/<bridge id>/bridge.json instead of environment variables
why: a probe showed LC_* variables set on Code.exe never reached the extension host of a normal window (bridge activated, no port)
result: file handoff works on every run

decision: launch() resolves only after the bridge file exists (extension host up), not when the workbench DOM appears
why: the first lane 2 screenshot was taken before contributed views registered and lacked the LAN Collab activity bar icon
result: icon visible; perf median still 7.7 s

decision: scratch profiles default to window.dialogStyle=custom plus quiet settings (no startup editor, AI features, telemetry, updates, secondary sidebar)
why: native modal dialogs are invisible to CDP and block the window; noise changes screenshots between runs
result: custom dialogs render in the workbench DOM

decision: close() kills the tree by parent PID plus any process whose command line names the scratch profile, then waits until the OS process list no longer shows them
why: Windows keeps killed processes listed for 1-8 s; an immediate check reported them as orphans
result: no orphan Code.exe after close in lanes 5-7 and 10

decision: palette() opens the palette with workbench.action.showCommands instead of Ctrl+Shift+P
why: with a webview focused the key event stayed inside the webview and the palette never opened

decision: app.mjs is a working generic launcher (LANHUB_APP_EXE or LanHub.exe under lanhub target folders) that throws "LAN Hub app not built" when none exists, rather than a bare stub
why: A7 then only has to confirm the path; the stub behaviour the spec asks for is unchanged
result: stub path proven; real WebView2 path unproven until A7

decision: lane 5 hub root carries the same .vscode/settings.json as the clients
why: without it the first sync wants to upload settings.json and the extension asks for confirmation in a modal, so neither member connects; test/vscode/run.js does the same

decision: package-lock.json is created by this PR
why: the repo had no lockfile; adding ffmpeg-static@5.3.0 (2025-11-14) produced one

decision: Webview.click re-clicks a focusable element until it holds focus (max 3); lane 10 now asserts typed values instead of only "no error"
why: at the first committed head lane 10 typed into the chat webview but the textarea stayed empty: the workbench took focus back after the first click
result: 4 of 4 lane 10 runs type "verb" into the textarea
